name: Condition Imposed
description: Forces a target to make a saving throw or suffer a condition, with no damage attached.

mechanics.text: On activation, a target that fails a saving throw suffers a condition — no damage involved at all (see feat.area-damage-burst/feat.extra-damage for the damage-bearing versions of this same save shape). Which condition, save ability/DC, and duration live in this record's own featureParams. Cost scales by how severe the imposed condition actually is (this Feature's own tier below) rather than needing a separate one-off Feature per condition word — budget analysis confirmed a flat cost here tracked the level/rarity curve no better than feat.damage's own flat cost did, for the same reason (real power varies a lot — paralyzed and prone are not remotely the same threat — and a single flat number can't say so).
A condition that's a real inconvenience but rarely swings a fight on its own — frightened, blinded, deafened, prone, grappled, and similar.
A condition with real tactical weight — poisoned, charmed, restrained, exhausted, possessed, and similar.
A condition that effectively takes the target out of the fight — stunned, incapacitated, unconscious, banished, and similar.
The most dangerous save-or-suffer outcomes in the game — paralyzed, petrified — where a failed save routinely means auto-crits and total helplessness.
